description: Multiple-testing ledger (spec §13). Deterministic: no wall-clock; identical rerun => identical file. Experiments are de-duplicated by (alpha_id, kind, canonical config, dataset_version): re-running the same script on the same dataset does not inflate the Bonferroni denominator; the same configuration on a new dataset is a new look, and the looks of earlier datasets are kept (`datasets`). An entry judged under the ledger t-stat policy carries `gate_looks`, the look count its threshold was derived from.

config.rule: advanced models run only if the best linear pooled OOS IC vs the MID-TO-MID label is > 0 (the cost-adjusted target embeds the observable half-spread)

clustered.rule: advanced models run only if the best linear fold-mean rank IC vs the MID-TO-MID label is > 0 AND the day-clustered t of its pooled (per-fold standardised) OOS predictions is >= 2

literal.rule: advanced models run only if the best linear pooled OOS IC vs the MID-TO-MID label is > 0 (the cost-adjusted target embeds the observable half-spread)

config.rule: argmax mean OOS IC over the trained models

config.selection: best_tau = argmax total_net_bps on the calibration segment
